objective: Admit and persist the bounded non-personal TED eForms source profile through isolated retrieval and admission credentials connected to authenticated ResearchRuns.
outcome: An authenticated procurement ResearchRun retrieves up to four official XML notices, persists only sanitised non-personal evidence, creates a durable admission handoff, independently redownloads and rederives claims under a separate credential, and returns canonical claims and a traceable dossier without raw XML or personal values.

skills.activation_reason: Own the bounded PRODUCT_ADMITTED source profile and revocation decision.
Prohibit personal and ambiguous organisation identity values from persistence.
Pin direct official XML retrieval to publication-number URLs and budgets.
Persist hashes, notice lineage, Evidence Objects and rederivable claims without raw XML.
Redownload and rederive claims before any canonical write.
Prove two-credential isolation, SSRF resistance, rollback and kill switches.
Exercise migration replay, end-to-end persistence, tamper blocking and restore.
Keep bounded source admission separate from public universe launch.

allowed_scope: One explicit lifecycle of one to four TED publication numbers
Official direct XML retrieval with strict host and path allowlist
Sanitised non-personal Evidence Objects and observed claims
PostgreSQL and Valkey persistence, replay and rollback evidence
prohibited_scope: Raw TED XML persistence or redistribution
Unrestricted search iteration or bulk ingestion
Model training or model canonical authority
Public launch, marketing, billing or bid execution

acceptance_evidence.description: Official rights and privacy review admits only the non-personal derived profile.
Unit tests prove URL pinning, profile filtering, job contracts and personal-value exclusion.
Official SDK 1.14.2 provides complete correction and subtype-29 result samples without raw-value artifact persistence.
Migrations 070 and 071 replay idempotently, the pre-070 snapshot restores, and failpoints leave zero partial state.
Real database roles prove worker canonical writes and admission Evidence mutations are denied; the worker may update only candidate_claims.updated_at for idempotent replay.
Runbook defines operation, privacy, authority, kill switch, rollback and promotion limits.

alerts: raw XML or personal value persisted

rollback.strategy: Enable the TED source kill switch, disable AXIGNAL_TED_RESEARCH_ENABLED, stop both TED workers, quarantine pending handoffs, preserve immutable evidence and restore the pre-070 database snapshot when schema rollback is required.
rollback.kill_switch: src_ted_search_api_v3 remains independently revocable; disabling it blocks both retrieval and admission.

goal_lock_checks.evidence: The source creates a real recurring European procurement investigation workflow.
Every persisted fact binds to publication number, notice version, source path and XML hash.
Procedure, lot, geography and lifecycle facts support Globe, Graph and Timeline.
User interest cannot alter source facts, policy gates or admission outcomes.
Source values remain exact; identity values are excluded rather than translated or guessed.
Independent redownload and immutable lineage differentiate AXIGNAL from generic summarisation.
No suitability, profitability, recommendation, bid submission or representation is enabled.
Rights, privacy, third-party content and attribution are encoded as fail-closed gates.
Kill switch, feature flag, credential separation and snapshot restore preserve reversibility.
This is the exact authorised gate following parser, lifecycle and sandbox admission evidence.
